description: Generate one first-class Library media item from a prompt. Choose generator: text-to-video | text-to-image | image-to-video | text-to-music | text-to-speech | text-to-sfx | auto. Put supported presentation controls in body.style and first/last/image references in body.refs. Returns { id, status:"generating", estimateUsd? }; returns 402 if the estimate exceeds the per-call ceiling. Async — call wait_job(kind="media", id=mediaItemId) or use a webhook (media.completed — status rides the payload). Use the returned id like any other media item.

style.description: Free-form generation parameters, read per generator. All generators honor `aspect` (string) + `durationSec` (number) where applicable. text-to-speech honors `voice` (string; default voice when omitted), `speed` (number 0.7-1.2), `stability` (number 0-1), and `styleExaggeration` (number 0-1 → the endpoint's style exaggeration). Provider and model selection are server-owned and cannot be overridden.

commandId.description: Retry identity. A call repeated with the same commandId returns the first result instead of acting twice.
